facts.text: Public product literature shows that automatic intervention is commercially viable off-road; this evidence consists of vendor claims.
facts.quote: Public product literature proves that automatic intervention is commercially viable off-road.

facts.text: Public product literature shows narrow present operating envelopes for off-road automatic intervention: reversing or rear-zone operation, low speed, brief brake pulses, or dependence on tags.
facts.quote: It also shows how narrow present operating envelopes are: reversing or rear-zone operation, low speed, brief brake pulses, or dependence on tags.

facts.text: Public documentation for commercially offered off-road automatic braking or stopping rarely states complete weather, visibility, road-surface, object-class or false-positive limits.
facts.quote: Public documentation rarely states complete weather, visibility, road-surface, object-class or false-positive limits.

facts.text: No independent performance test was found for any of the off-road automatic braking or stopping products covered by the vendor claims.
facts.quote: All entries are vendor claims; no independent performance test of any of them was found.
